svg.aria-label: The seven Atlas experiments. Experiment 01 is the scalability baseline that builds the k6 harness and the reference numbers; the other six are correctness, resilience and architecture probes measured against it. Five have passed, one is implemented but not yet run, and one produced a finding about event retention.

text.tspan: · seven probes, each with a runnable artifact and a written result
